title: Schema Delta Addendum v1 — Actual schema as built (reconciles SRS addendum v2 data-model sketch)
sources: src/db.py (SCHEMA_STATEMENTS + _ensure_columns) — authoritative for every column listed here
docs/SRS_DK_Bond_Tracker_addendum_v2.json (Data model deltas section — the sketch this document reconciles)

sections.heading: Bonds table — complete column list
sections.body: Every column of bonds as built, from src/db.py SCHEMA_STATEMENTS plus the _ensure_columns ALTER path for legacy databases. Base columns (W0/W2 schema): id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY — row identity; company TEXT — display name and active-position lock name-key; isin TEXT UNIQUE — external bond identifier and second lock key; name TEXT — legacy label (import mirrors company into it); amount REAL — principal TL invested (portfolio Total Investment input, AF-13); maturity REAL — maturity TL amount per bond (Balance = Till Return − Maturity, AF-13; W2 status/totals engine — also backfilled by _ensure_columns ALTER for pre-W2 databases); start_date TEXT — exact position start date (W2, AF-50 legacy mapping writes ISO dates); end_date TEXT — exact position end date (W2, AF-50); tenure_months INTEGER — window length in months driving the status engine (W2, AF-14..AF-16); credit_day INTEGER CHECK (credit_day >= 1 AND credit_day <= 28) — due day of month for the day-wise sweep and alert cadence (W2, AF-46); status TEXT DEFAULT 'On-going' — persisted Danger/On-going/Completed state written only by the status engine (W2, AF-14..AF-16); created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP — insert time. Watch-analytics columns added by _ensure_columns (W6, AF-32 watch-list analytics inputs, DATA-04): face_value REAL — face value used for discount = face − investment; tlp_amount REAL — TLP amount used for qty TL = tlp × qty; payment_type TEXT — free-text payment cycle label; payment_cycle_of() in src/phase4.py maps it to monthly/quarterly/yearly for the payout schedule (AF-36); interest_payout REAL — per-cycle interest payout used by TDS computation (AF-35); qty REAL — quantity of units; watch_investment REAL — watch-sheet invested amount, the discount and free-up input. Related ledger table (unchanged from W2): payment_ledger(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bond_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bonds(id), month TEXT, amount REAL, paid INTEGER DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE (bond_id, month)) — one row per bond-month; no per-month columns ever added on bonds (TC-20).

sections.heading: financial_goals — complete column list
sections.body: Base columns (W1 Home Plan import, AF-05): id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY; name TEXT — goal label; target_amount REAL — savings target; target_end_date TEXT — ISO end date, NULL marks a legacy irregular-savings goal (is_legacy in src/goals.py); note TEXT — free text (legacy import writes 'legacy home plan'). Progress column added by _ensure_columns: saved_amount REAL DEFAULT 0 — amount saved so far; W6/AF-41 (Financial Goals surface) progress input: progress_pct = saved_amount / target_amount × 100 computed on view in src/goals.py _decorate, never stored.

sections.heading: notifications — actual shape
sections.body: As built in src/db.py SCHEMA_STATEMENTS: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY; created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; severity TEXT — free-text severity ('danger' for missed credit-day events, 'reminder' for before-due, 'due_today' for day-of, 'warn' for delivery/system notices); message TEXT — full human-readable alert text rendered on the bell dropdown and /notifications page; read INTEGER DEFAULT 0 — unread flag flipped by mark_all_read. There are no position-ref, channel or delivery-status columns. Reconciliation: the wave-2 SRS v2 delta sketch mentioned position ref, alert type, channel, timestamp and delivery status; AS BUILT — the position reference and alert type are folded into the message text (company, credit day, month are written into message by src/app.py _startup_alerts and src/notifications.py due_reminders); channel is folded into dual-dispatch behavior (in-app bell row is always written, email is attempted when SMTP_* env is configured via src/mailer.py — channel is a behavior, not a column); delivery outcome is recorded as a notifications row with severity 'warn' and message text 'email failed: <error>' (src/app.py _attempt_email); de-duplication uses alert_prefs keys, not a notifications column — key patterns: danger:<bond_id>:<YYYY-MM-DD> (credit-day miss, once per bond per day, src/app.py), due:<bond_id>:<YYYY-MM> (before-due reminder, once per bond per month, src/notifications.py), dayof:<bond_id>:<YYYY-MM> (day-of reminder, once per bond per month, src/notifications.py).

sections.heading: alert_prefs + share_config — actual shapes and purposes
sections.body: alert_prefs (src/db.py): id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY; key TEXT UNIQUE; value TEXT. Purpose in the as-built app: (a) de-duplication ledger for notify_once — key patterns danger:<bond_id>:<YYYY-MM-DD>, due:<bond_id>:<YYYY-MM>, dayof:<bond_id>:<YYYY-MM> with value '1'; (b) sweep watermark — key 'last_sweep' with value = ISO date of the last successful daily sweep (src/app.py _startup_alerts, INSERT OR REPLACE). It does NOT store per-position cadence preferences or an SMTP setup flag; email configuration lives in environment variables (SMTP_HOST/SMTP_PORT/SMTP_USER/SMTP_APP_PASSWORD/ALERT_TO, src/mailer.py). share_config (src/db.py): id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY; section TEXT; included INTEGER DEFAULT 0 — one row per share-snapshot section flag, the schema surface for the FR-29 last-used per-section selections (totals, per_bond, history, alerts — SECTION_KEYS in src/share.py). As built, the share route applies the selections submitted with each request (checkbox POST state); no route currently reads or writes share_config rows — the table exists from init_db and is asserted by TC-19, reserved for persisting last-used selections.

sections.heading: reconciliation
sections.body: This addendum documents the schema exactly as implemented in src/db.py and supersedes the data-model deltas sketch in SRS_DK_Bond_Tracker_addendum_v2 wherever the two differ — specifically: (1) notifications has no position-ref/channel/delivery-status columns (see the notifications section for the as-built folding); (2) alert_prefs holds dedupe keys and the last_sweep watermark only, not per-position cadence preferences, an SMTP setup flag or a channel set; (3) share_config is created by init_db but is not yet wired to a route — selection state currently lives in the per-request form. No requirement text in any SRS document is changed by this addendum; it is a data-model truth document only.

sections.heading: supersedes-delta
sections.body: Supersedes the notifications sketch inside the 'Data model deltas (documentation of deltas, not SQL)' section of docs/SRS_DK_Bond_Tracker_addendum_v2.json — the sketch line 'notifications: new — alert history rows (position ref, alert type, channel, timestamp, delivery status) retained in-app for audit' is replaced by the as-built shape documented in the 'notifications — actual shape' section above. The alert_prefs sketch line in the same SRS section ('per-position/global preference for before-due / day-of / overdue cadence, Gmail SMTP setup flag, channel set') is likewise replaced by the as-built alert_prefs purpose documented above. All other deltas in that SRS sketch (bonds start_date/end_date/credit_day, financial_goals target fields, share_config intent) match the as-built schema and stay in force.
